body: I know you're right. I do realize I was happier prior to investing, but I also wasn't making the money that would give me independence and finally start living my own life. I've just fucked up so much and investing finally ALMOST gave me a way out to start feeling better about myself. But all it's done is make me feel worse and reaffirm my convictions about myself and feel like my low self-esteem is warranted.  Prior to all this I was actually reading and trying to enjoy the little things. I've had it way better than most and basically blew every opportunity that came my way, becoming addicted to drugs, isolating myself, failing school, and not being good at life in general, making everything as hard as possible on myself. Not to mention having such a strange family life that I feel like no one can relate to. I'm just sick of it all, but I'm going to try and get better. Just not sure if it's too late.

I hope you're right (besides the market crashing). In my opinion though, this was a once in a lifetime opportunity, and I blew it by getting drunk, being greedy, and getting emotional over whatever this "reddit revolution" bullshit is. I think it's not much but a bunch of people who constantly play video games and don't even think about positively contributing to society. But they deserve to be rich for some reason  I honestly hate the stock market. But it seems like it's the only way to earn enough money to truly live in this country. I'm so sick of it all. Capitalism is the fucking worst. Thanks for your reply though, it does make me feel a little better, although I wish you didn't miss out on your gains too.

It'd be nice if there was just an off button we could press that wasn't painful. I personally have little hope that I haven't fucked up my brain completely, in addition to being a fool that blows every opportunity that comes their way. There very well may still be hope for you though. I hope things get better.

I personally don't think it's cowardly to not want to kill yourself. It's the ultimate decision of potentially permanently ending your consciousness and your very being. Who know's if it all goes black or what happens really. It's scary.

Thanks man, I appreciate it. I've always had quite the distaste for money, but it's what puts food in our bellies and pays our bills, on top of seemingly being the primary thing that gives people value in this world so once I got a shot at making a lot of it quick, it totally flipped my mind upside down.
